unit: ms round trip, probe to probe
note: The Middle East is Bahrain. This matrix is noisier than the others — several probes in the region route the long way round and read three or four times what the distance allows (Beirut 309 ms to a server 1,600 km away, Baghdad 162, New Delhi 245 against Bangalore's 72). The outlier guard drops those and the fill model stands in, and every one it drops is printed.
